mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park and the First Quarter moon is visible. Tonight's low will be 32 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

The city is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which includes replacing three bridges to improve accessibility. A public information meeting is scheduled for December 8 from 5:00 to 6:30 PM at the Verona Senior Center to discuss the construction schedule and detours. Additionally, residents are reminded that all refuse and recycling carts should be placed forward-facing at the end of the driveway by 7:00 AM on collection days.

Looking ahead, there are several ways to stay active in Verona. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking further into the week, you can test your knowledge at The Bogey Factory on Wednesday or catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard this Friday.
Regarding the recent police report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash occurred in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue where a driver was arrested for O W I with a minor in the vehicle.

Our store is currently closed for the night. We hope you enjoyed the Chocolate Volcano flavor today, and we invite you to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy our featured flavor of the day, Caramel Turtle.
